03 / HOW IT WORKS
Every sale repays a little.
Customer pays $10
the split · 10%
$9 to the shop
$1 to repayment
Lender vaults
Private Business Pass
zkTLS proves the business from its seller dashboard. We never ask for a name, phone or contacts.
Code-capped agents
AI underwrites, a separate Critic catches wash trading, and the contract caps every draw.
A record you own
Each repaid advance mints a ZK Standing Pass: a higher limit, with no history revealed.
One flat fee, shown upfront · no interest · no late fees · a bad week only slows repayment
DripMoni
BUILT WITH · UNISWAP
The market prices default risk.
JUNIOR TOKEN
First loss, listed
The junior tranche is an ERC-4626 vault. Its shares trade against USDC on a v4 pool.
RISKHOOK FEE
Swaps fund the reserve
A USDC-only fee on swaps, flushed to the reserve that covers losses after junior.
TWAP ORACLE
Price drops, limits drop
The risk agent compares the 1h and 24h TWAP. A fall of over 10% lowers lending limits.
DripMoni
BUILT WITH · WORLD
Only at the human moments.
AGENT PASS
Delegate once
The approval is bound to one agent key and its limits. After that, nobody taps. Declined: no mandate, no draws.
NOT IN CREDIT
Never sees the shop
World plays no part in underwriting. It never learns which business or what was borrowed.
IDKIT
Recover on a new phone
Proof of Human unlocks an encrypted backup of the merchant’s credentials. Same human, same backup.
DripMoni
BUILT WITH · ETHEREUM FOUNDATION
ZK needs network privacy too.
ANON-RPC
THE LEAK
Proofs hide the leaf
But asking an RPC for your Merkle path, balance or sales tells it which shop is yours.
READS
Whole tree, local path
The app reads through Anon-RPC, downloads every leaf and builds the proof path on the device.
WRITES
Relayer, not wallet
Anon-RPC is read-only, so draws and claims go through our relayer. The merchant’s wallet never appears.
